sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Pandey,Kamlendra Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Raj Narayan Gupta Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
List revised.
No one appears on behalf of the informant.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for applicant is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Mobin, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 81 of 2021, under Sections 498A,304B,120B,201 IPC and section 3/4 D.P. Act Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District- Bulandshahr, during pendency of trial.

entities.text: D.P. Act Police Station Kotwali Dehat
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Mobin vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3746102/
1
There is allegation against the applicant of causing dowry death of his wife by throttling.
The marriage of the couple took place on 11.2.2020.
Learned AGA has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.
This Court after hearing the learned counsels for the parties does not finds any ground for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage.
The bail application is accordingly rejected.

The court below is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant, as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Atul kr. sri.
